name: infinite-moving-cards

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows a complete quote card and its author cleanly; later frames blend two cards into one ghosted block.

tagline: A steady row of dark quote cards slides sideways and repeats.
summary: A horizontal strip of dark rounded testimonial cards that scrolls sideways on a loop, the list duplicated so it never ends. Each card holds a quote, a name and a role.
appearance: A band of wide, dark rounded cards on black, each carrying two or three lines of pale grey quote text and, below, a name and job title in smaller grey type. Cards run off both edges and fade into the black through a soft gradient mask.
behaviour: The cards slide steadily leftward and loop without a seam because the whole list is cloned. Hovering any card pauses the slide, and it picks up again when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Five testimonials from Alice Johnson, Bob Martinez, Carol Chen, David Kim and Emma Wilson with job titles.
search_phrases: motion strip of praise from customers
use_when: Several testimonials need to cycle through a narrow band without arrows or dots.
avoid_when: Visitors need to read every quote at their own pace, or motion must stop for accessibility.
customise: items supplies each quote, name and title, and direction, speed and pauseOnHover are props. Card width, colours and the edge fade live in the classes.
weight_why: One CSS keyframe moving a duplicated list of quote cards.

a11y.note: Continuous motion with no pause control except hover and no reduced-motion check, so touch users cannot stop it.

props.name: items
props.type: { quote: string; name: string; title: string }[]

issues: Frames 3, 5 and 6 blend two cards together, so their quotes are unreadable.
The strip never stops for touch users, since pausing is hover-only.
polish_why: Clean, legible testimonial strip with a soft fade, but a standard marquee with little character.
title: Infinite Moving Cards
